meta.title: What Are Bonds?
meta.style_suffix: Pixar-style 3D cartoon, vibrant saturated colors, soft three-point cinematic lighting, large expressive eyes, exaggerated micro-expressions, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16 composition, premium animation quality

music.mood: light futuristic beats, soft bass, modern finance short

scenes.narration: Wait... people get PAID just for lending money?
scenes.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of Mia, a Pixar-style 3D animated young woman in her mid-twenties with warm brown skin, shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, large expressive hazel eyes, wearing a soft pink hoodie. She is holding a crisp ten dollar bill up near her face, looking sideways at it with one eyebrow raised high and a slight skeptical squint, mouth tilted in a confused half-smirk. Background slightly dark with glowing blurred neon city lights at night, bokeh, cinematic moody lighting from one side, vertical composition centered on her face, headroom above
scenes.motion_prompt: Quick dramatic zoom in on Mia's face, her eyes dart sideways, eyebrow flicks up, subtle head tilt

scenes.narration: When governments or companies need money to build things, they sell bonds — basically big IOUs.
scenes.image_prompt: Mia, a Pixar-style 3D animated young woman in her mid-twenties with warm brown skin, shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, large expressive hazel eyes, wearing a soft pink hoodie, standing in front of a giant futuristic government building under construction, holographic blue scaffolding glowing around it. She is curiously holding out a single glowing gold coin toward the building, eyes wide with curiosity, lips slightly pursed, head tilted thoughtfully. Wide medium shot from behind-side angle showing both Mia and the rising hologram city, warm golden hour light mixed with blue holographic glow, vertical composition with the building towering above her
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow camera pull back revealing the scale, holographic city slowly rises in the background, Mia's coin glows brighter

scenes.narration: You lend them money today, and they pay you back later — with extra cash on top, called interest. Every month, like clockwork.
scenes.image_prompt: Mia, a Pixar-style 3D animated young woman in her mid-twenties with warm brown skin, shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, large expressive hazel eyes, wearing a soft pink hoodie. She holds open a glowing leather wallet as a steady stream of golden coins rains down into it from above, an animated contract scroll floating beside her with a glowing percent symbol. Her face is lit up in pleasant surprise turning to joy, eyes wide and sparkling, mouth open in a big delighted smile, slight excited head tilt. Cinematic warm lighting with gold sparkle particles, vertical composition centered on Mia and the wallet, soft purple background with gold accents
scenes.motion_prompt: Coins rain steadily down into the wallet, sparkles float upward, Mia's smile widens, camera slowly pushes in

scenes.narration: Stocks can grow way faster, but they're a wild ride. Bonds? Way steadier — slower growth, fewer surprises.
scenes.image_prompt: Split-screen vertical composition showing two side-by-side futuristic glass elevators inside a sleek skyscraper. Left elevator labeled STOCKS shakes wildly with chaotic motion blur, sparks flying, red warning lights, Mia inside it looking nervous with hair blowing around, mouth in a worried grimace, eyes wide and anxious. Right elevator labeled BONDS rises smoothly and calmly with cool blue light, a second Mia inside looking relaxed and serene with a peaceful soft smile, eyes half-closed contentedly. Both Mias are the same Pixar-style 3D animated young woman in her mid-twenties with warm brown skin, shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, large expressive hazel eyes, wearing a soft pink hoodie. Cinematic dramatic lighting contrast, vertical 9:16 split composition
scenes.motion_prompt: Left elevator shakes and jolts violently, right elevator glides smoothly upward, lighting flickers red on left and stays calm blue on right

scenes.narration: That's why smart investors often use both. Grow with stocks. Protect with bonds.
scenes.image_prompt: Mia, a Pixar-style 3D animated young woman in her mid-twenties with warm brown skin, shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, large expressive hazel eyes, wearing a soft pink hoodie, standing confidently on a rooftop overlooking a glowing futuristic city skyline at sunset, hands on hips, a holographic portfolio chart floating beside her perfectly balanced with green growth arrows and blue shield icons. Her expression is calm proud confidence, relaxed satisfied smile, determined sparkling eyes, slight proud nod. Cinematic golden hour light from behind creating a warm rim light around her hair, wide low-angle hero shot from below making her look powerful, vertical composition with city skyline below and warm orange sky above
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow cinematic camera push in on Mia, wind gently moves her hair, holographic chart rotates softly, city lights twinkle below
